searchText: not sure what you're trying to achieve 😄 It looks like the key you've started goomy with just has no funds? besides of that, there are 2 executables included with goomy: `blob-spammer` & `blob-sender`. The `blob-spammer` is intended to do mass blob spamming and therefore needs a few child wallets to be able to send blobs in parallel. The other tool `blob-sender` is much easier and sends a single blob from the provided key only. why can't I use blob-spammer with a single wallet from the provided key only? that's what I wanted to do hmm, yea, I see. It currently doesn't support that unfortunately. But you can use `--max-wallets 1` to create a single child wallet only, which is almost the same. It tries to prefund the child wallets with 5 ETH, so be sure you have that amount in the root wallet. it doesn't transfer funds correctly to the child wallet ```INFO[0000] starting blob testing tool version=git- WARN[0000] client check completed (1 good clients, 0 bad clients) INFO[0001] initialized root wallet (addr: 0xc6D66bfca39d5f8f8afb765CD9e099623727f105 balance: 0 ETH, nonce: 0) INFO[0001] funding child wallets... (0/1) WARN[0002] could not send funding tx: insufficient funds for gas * price + value ``` I have 23 ETH in the root wallet

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
not sure what you're trying to achieve 😄
It looks like the key you've started goomy with just has no funds?

besides of that, there are 2 executables included with goomy:  `blob-spammer` & `blob-sender`.
The `blob-spammer` is intended to do mass blob spamming and therefore needs a few child wallets to be able to send blobs in parallel.
The other tool `blob-sender` is much easier and sends a single blob from the provided key only.

excerpts.author: 0xevan
excerpts.content: why can't I use blob-spammer with a single wallet from the provided key only?

excerpts.author: 0xevan
excerpts.content: that's what I wanted to do

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
hmm, yea, I see.  It currently doesn't support that unfortunately.

But you can use `--max-wallets 1` to create a single child wallet only, which is almost the same.
It tries to prefund the child wallets with 5 ETH, so be sure you have that amount in the root wallet.
